notes: All 12 views inspected. Centre-cab diesel shunter with two long hoods, cream cab roof, body-side louvre grilles, walkway handrails on both sides, roof fans and horns, headlight and marker lenses, buffers and couplers at both ends, and two three-axle bogies with modelled brake gear. The underside view shows a complete chassis, fuel tank and bogie frames rather than a hollow shell. Both ends are fully modelled and the model is symmetric as a centre-cab unit should be. No operator name, number or logo anywhere.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
Wheels and bogies are part of the single body mesh, so unlike the Grab3D road vehicles this cannot be given a wheel-roll clip without separating the mesh.
Cab interior is not modelled; the window glass is a separate opaque-ish lens node.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
